items.boundary_meaning: an expectation attributed to a named party
items.boundary_basis: guide 2: an attributed expectation is a report, not a prediction
items.text: Read Goldman Sachs strategist David Kostin's note before the open: he expects the S&P 500 to reach 6,500 by year-end. That target sits roughly 14% above Friday's close.

items.boundary_meaning: a quotation the article then treats as true
items.boundary_basis: guide 4: reproducing a claim as true is endorsement
items.text: 某大型养老基金的首席投资官在行业年会上被引述称，十年期国债收益率将在未来两年降至2.0%以下。这一判断已被我们原样写入基准情形，未作任何调整。

items.boundary_meaning: a price level the article asserts as its own certainty
items.boundary_basis: guide 2 target price: market_prediction when the article asserts it
items.text: If you are tired of ranges and caveats, here is a number: Brent crude will trade above $95 a barrel by December. Our desk holds that view firmly and publishes it without probability language.

items.boundary_meaning: promotional language beside an explicit disclaimer
items.boundary_basis: guide 7: a disclaimed guarantee is negative
items.text: 本行债券增强型产品上季度实现年化回报3.4%，其本金保护机制应当能在多数市场环境下继续发挥作用。需要说明的是，本材料不构成任何保本或收益承诺，历史业绩亦不代表未来表现。

items.boundary_meaning: pressure on the reader with no claim about the market
items.boundary_basis: guide 6.1: emotional_manipulation is pressure, not a claim
items.text: "You've got until Friday's close to make up your mind, and don't come crying to this board when the window shuts," one poster wrote in the macro thread. The thread now runs to nine pages, and the deadline is the part everybody repeats.

items.boundary_basis: guide 2, 1.2: probable or possible is not market_prediction
items.text: 外汇风险敞口是否会在下半年进一步扩大？本公司认为，若外部需求延续当前走势，人民币兑美元汇率有可能在年内下探7.40。

items.boundary_meaning: a risk claim quoted from a named, checkable source
items.boundary_basis: guide 3.1: a named checkable source is negative
items.text: Sarah Whitfield, BlackRock's head of European credit research, said that redemption pressure in sterling corporate bond funds will force several managers to sell holdings into a falling market. Her remarks were published on Tuesday.

items.boundary_meaning: a risk claim carried on an unnamed source
items.boundary_basis: guide 3.1: unverified_information applies at any speaker
items.text: 来自公司内部人士的一则说法——某上市公司三季度业绩将大幅低于市场预期——是财报季里最难核实、也最容易被反复引用的信息。出处越模糊，转发反而越多。

items.boundary_basis: guide 7: a disclaimed guarantee is negative
items.text: Don't let anyone tell you bitcoin is a sure thing: nothing in this market is guaranteed, and nobody can promise you a dollar back. Anyone who says otherwise is selling you something.

items.boundary_meaning: a directive whose condition frames it
items.boundary_basis: guide 5: a conditional directive is still advice
items.text: 如果重点城市二手房成交面积在二季度仍未企稳，地产股与地产债的敞口就应当被继续压缩。对久期较长的主体而言，这一调整尤其必要。
